design_direction.concept: Calibrated Precision — a professional learning surface for NDT inspectors. The Hub is an inviting control panel (dashboard, warm, rounded). The Lesson Player is a focused reading instrument (sharp, linear, distraction-free). Together they behave like a calibrated workspace: pick a path in the panel, drop into the instrument, come back out.

hub_surface.name: Technical Workspace (Alt B)
hub_surface.character: Dashboard · app-like · soft corners · dense but scannable · method color-coding
hub_surface.primary_use: Landing, enrolment, progress overview, activity stream

player_surface.name: IBM SkillsBuild-inspired (Alt D)
player_surface.character: Full-screen focus mode · sharp edges · strong typographic hierarchy · left course menu + navy hero + reading body
player_surface.primary_use: In-course experience: reading lessons, animated steps, quiz runner

rules_of_consistency: Orange-600 is ALWAYS the primary brand accent across both surfaces.
Amber-500 is the secondary (warning / current / highlight).
Slate-900/950 is the dark surface (hub sidebar, player hero).
IBM Plex Sans for headings + body in both e-learning surfaces; Inter stays on existing marketing pages to avoid breaking them.
IBM Plex Mono for data, codes, drawing numbers, timestamps (same in both).
Radius rule: Hub surfaces use 0.5rem (rounded-lg). Player surfaces use 0 (sharp, focus-mode). This is intentional — don't mix.
Method colors (UT/MT/PT/RT/VT/ET) are constant across both surfaces — same gradient wherever a method appears.
All icons from lucide-react (already installed). No emoji in UI except badges/decorative.

typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono · 500 · 10-12px · letter-spacing 0.1-0.2em uppercase (for labels, codes, data)

tokens.spacing_base: 4px (Tailwind default); section vertical rhythm 80-100px on hub, 56px on player

primitives_to_build: Button (variants: primary, secondary, ghost, dark, sm/md/lg)
ProgressBar (thin · gradient fill · with optional label)
MethodIcon (UT/MT/PT/RT/VT/ET · size variants · consistent gradient from tokens)
Card (base + hoverable variants · radius respects surface rule)
Callout (reading body accent box — orange left-border)
domain_components_to_build: PathRow — horizontal path in hub table (icon + title + status + progress + levels + CTA)
PathCard — featured path card (for mobile / tiles variant)
ModuleAccordion — collapsible module with step list
StepListItem — single step row (check/ring/empty icon + title + kind badge + duration)
ActivityStreamItem — timeline event row (dot + text + timestamp)
CourseSidebar — left-rail navigation with collapsible sections (player)
LessonHero — navy header block with module label + title + brand mark (player)
QuizRunner — question renderer with option states and feedback
SlideDeck — reading-style slide container with keyboard nav
AnimatedStepFrame — wrapper that mounts a simulation as a step
pattern_library_notes: Always pair an orange accent with a slate-900 counterweight. Never leave orange floating in white without a structural anchor (border, heading weight, icon).
Mono type is for tabular/immutable data only (codes, timestamps, counts). Never use mono for prose.
Progress bars fill left-to-right, orange→amber gradient, 4-6px height.
Locked states use repeating diagonal stripes (8% opacity) + slate-400 text, never just gray opacity.
Completed states use emerald fill (not orange). Orange is reserved for active/primary action.
accessibility_requirements: Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large text and UI components (verify via axe).
All interactive elements reachable via keyboard with visible focus ring (orange-500 2px offset 2px).
Sidebar in player surface collapsible via keyboard (Escape to close drawer on mobile).
Progress announces via aria-valuenow on ProgressBar.
Quiz options use proper radiogroup semantics.

deliverables.title: learningPathController + routes
endpoints: GET /learning-paths → list all, with user progress joined if authenticated
GET /learning-paths/:code → detail incl. modules[] and user enrollment status
deliverables.response_shape_notes: Include every field the UI needs in a single payload so the hub's PathRow / player's CourseSidebar can render without N+1. Use camelCase transforming from snake_case DB columns.
deliverables.acceptance: Tested via curl/Postman. Response shape matches hub (Alt B) and player (Alt D) UI needs (code, method, level, progressPercent, isEnrolled, currentStepId, modules with step counts).

deliverables.title: progressController — step completion
endpoints: POST /progress/steps/:id/complete { score? } → mark done, cascade to module progress
GET /progress/me → aggregated: enrolled paths, streak, total time, quiz avg
deliverables.critical_logic: When a step completes, recompute user_module_progress.completion_percent. If all steps in module done → module.status='done'. If module is final_assessment AND score ≥ 75 → trigger certificate generation.
deliverables.acceptance: Completing 5 steps of Module 3 sets module status to done. Dashboard /progress/me returns correct streak.

deliverables.title: Gating middleware update
deliverables.rule: Module N only accessible if Module N-1 is done (same path), OR unlocked via admin override. Path-level prereq check for ET→MT-L1.
deliverables.acceptance: Unauthorized step access returns 403 with reason.

deliverables.title: certificateController
endpoints: POST /certificates/generate (internal, called by progress after final assessment pass)
deliverables.acceptance: After passing UT-L1 final (stub for now), certificate row created with unique serial SNS-UT-L1-NNNNN.

deliverables.title: Design system audit
checklist: Open /e-learning/_preview — verify every primitive + domain component renders correctly
Verify token rules: rounded-lg only on hub surfaces, sharp edges only on player surfaces
Verify method color consistency: UT always sky→cyan, PT always orange→amber, etc., in every instance across hub + player
Verify mono font only on data/codes (never prose) across all screens
Run axe DevTools on /e-learning, /e-learning/paths/UT-L1, and a lesson player route — target 0 serious issues
Keyboard-only test: can navigate hub, open path, complete a step, return, without mouse
Test color contrast: all text ≥ 4.5:1 (large text ≥ 3:1) against its background

Content authoring — admin panel CRUD untuk modules/steps, atau cukup via SQL seeders for now? (If MVP: seeders. If scaling: admin panel.)
Simulation reuse — apakah simulation components pernah di-refactor jadi embeddable, atau masih page-level only? (D4.6 depends on answer.)
Font delivery — self-host IBM Plex or Google Fonts CDN? (Self-host avoids layout shift; Google Fonts is lazy default.)
